title: Javier Bardem presents his first stage play in Madrid
summary: The Oscar winner stars in ¡Chéjov, Chéjov!, directed by his acting teacher.
body:
Javier Bardem presented his first stage production, ¡Chéjov, Chéjov!, in Madrid today, according to the Spanish news agency EFE.

The Oscar-winning actor has made dozens of films but has never before taken a leading role in the theatre. The show is directed by Juan Carlos Corazza, his acting teacher for many years.

About the play

It is built from a selection of short plays, stories and writings by the Russian author Anton Chekhov. The cast also includes Alicia Borrachero, Rafa Castejón and Manuela Velasco.

The production runs at Espacio Zafra Teatro in Madrid into early 2027.

Sources: EFE, elDiario.es, Infobae.
